note.note:
I can't generate the SOAP note until you provide the visit transcript and the DDx JSON. Please paste both (the full transcript followed by the DDx JSON). 

Helpful guidance:
- Provide the complete conversation transcript (physician and patient) — this is the primary source for findings.
- Provide the DDx JSON from the diagnostic agent.
- If available, include vitals, medication names (with doses if known), allergies, and any exam findings or investigation results.
- If any items are missing in the transcript (e.g., vitals), I will note them as missing in the Quality checks.

Once you post the transcript and DDx, I will produce the structured SOAP clinical note following your exact instructions.
